counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化层级化知识库文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中建立结构化的知识库
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up a structured knowledge base in your project

howto.what: 说「/init-deep」后,Claude 会扫描整个项目,给各目录按复杂度打分,在根目录和分值高的子目录分层生成 AGENTS.md 知识文件,内容含代码地图、约定、反模式等。
howto.when: 用户输入「/init-deep」命令时触发;加「--create-new」会先读后删再从零重建,加「--max-depth=N」限制目录深度(默认 3)。

say.text: 运行 /init-deep,更新并补齐项目的 AGENTS.md
say.note: 更新已有文件,缺失处新建

howto.what_en: After install, saying '/init-deep' makes Claude scan the project, score directories by complexity, and generate AGENTS.md files at the root and high-scoring subdirs, including a code map, conventions, and anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs the '/init-deep' command; appending '--create-new' deletes existing files and regenerates from scratch, while '--max-depth=N' limits scanning depth (default 3).

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to update and fill in the project's AGENTS.md files.
say_en.note: Updates existing files and creates new ones where warranted.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --create-new to regenerate all AGENTS.md from scratch.
say_en.note: Reads existing files first, deletes them, then regenerates.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --max-depth=2 to scan only two directory levels.
